effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol

publication.cost_scope: Stage and completed-attempt times are nested; prior failed attempts are separate costs.
publication.forgetting_definition: Both views use equal-weight mean over all old classes including Normal of best pre-final recall minus final recall, signed and unclipped; values are fractions (multiply by 100 for percentage points). Default uses uncalibrated decisions; operating points use calibrated fixed-FPR decisions, so values differ.
publication.scope: Single TB cell; no schedule-selection rule or five-seed test applied.
